task: Record the front-end implementation and verification state in the required handoffs. The original immutable plan covered the UI source but omitted the exact metadata paths required by the gate.
nonGoals: Changes to the original plan, evaluator, workflow, customer experience, or evidence requirements.

outcomes.description: Handoffs record the actual branch state, remaining integration, trace limits and replay commands.
outcomes.evidence: Both scoped handoffs and local PR gate.

process.description: Commit the metadata scope separately before creating either handoff.

styleEfficiency.description: Keep the handoffs focused on replay and decisions specific to their scopes.

exitTest.reason: Records state using the existing handoff schema and workflow. It does not change how tasks are transferred or resumed.
